scope: Independent visual physical-feature observations for the Figure79/Figure78 photographic overlap. Source JPEGs and raw pixel-axis crops only; no geographical coordinate, quarter name point, geographic transform or NCC model file is read.
coordinateConvention: Original JPEG integer pixel indices, x right/y down; manual uncertainty half-widths are interpretation ranges, not calibrated statistical error.

landmarks.physicalDetail: Northwest box in the conspicuous two-by-two dark rooftop-box group on the large retail building south of its main parking lot.
Small pale/blue-gray residential roof in the eastern block, at the same corner where the adjacent red-roof rows and angular street branches meet.

Visual center of the circular green roundabout island northwest of the retail roof. The southwest perimeter is partly overprinted by a source district line, but the island and most of the carriageway are visible.
Center of the larger saturated blue hall roof northeast of the roundabout, beside a smaller blue roof across the dark service lane.

observations.matchingDetails: The retail footprint, parking rows and two-by-two rooftop boxes, eastern house/roof constellation, roundabout island and paired blue-roof halls have matching shapes and arrangement.
observations.tonalDifference: The original maps highlight different source quarters; identical buildings are bright in one image and darkened in the other. This is retained as a map-graphic difference.

approvalScope: These local physical observations may independently test an image-to-image model. They do not validate a geographic calibration, southern/eastern extrapolation, a current neighborhood extent or address assignment.
